secondary.what: Her right ear shows a plain white pearl stud in the back views (Shot1/3/5) but a small dark stud with a pearl drop in the front views (Shot2/4/6).
Her hair is a twisted low bun in f0-f1 and becomes a long braid hanging down her back from f2 on.

Her shoulder in the right foreground looks like smooth bare orange skin with long straight hair, not the knit tan cardigan and wavy bob seen in Shot1/3/5 (blur may explain part of it).
